name: UIDAI document signer, May 2023 - Feb 2026 period (recovered)
provenance: Recovered from the RSA signatures of two genuine Aadhaar Secure QRs, a V3 generated Jul 2024 and a V5 generated Jul 2025, as N = gcd(s1^e - m1, s2^e - m2). No certificate is held for it: its link to UIDAI rests on those QRs being UIDAI-issued. Both verify under it; no certified key verifies either.
